description: Returns what this team wants its agents' work to look like: the standing rules in force and recent examples of what they like and don't. Call it before producing work the team will judge, and follow the rules. Pass category for one kind of work; rules that apply to everything are always included. Free.

category.description: The kind of work, as the team names it: social, logos, support replies

examples.description: How many recent examples to include. Default 12

name: get_standards
title: Read the team's standards
